metadata.header: Porto Taxi Driver Service and Schedule Habits
metadata.dataset_description: A constructed panel of 864 Porto taxi trips from 18 drivers, split evenly between ordinary and genuine pre-holiday operating-shift dates. Trips include service source, call-center caller identity, operating hour, and dense Porto road-aligned GPS paths; post-midnight records retain the preceding shift date separately from the timestamp date.

insight_list.insight: Some drivers rely mainly on call-center trips, while others have larger shares of taxi-stand or street-hail trips.

insights: Some drivers rely mainly on call-center trips, while others have larger shares of taxi-stand or street-hail trips.
Among call-center trips, some drivers repeatedly serve the same callers, while others serve a much more diverse caller pool.
Pre-holiday periods alter the active hours of some drivers substantially, while others maintain working-time patterns similar to ordinary days.
summary: Drivers exhibit call-center-, taxi-stand-, street-hail-, and balanced request-source mixes. Their call-center work ranges from repeated service to a few callers to broad caller pools. Pre-holiday schedules shift substantially for one driver group while remaining close to ordinary-day timing for the others.
